add.mobileHint: Formats as you type. We'll text the code.

add.unsupportedCountry: We can only text numbers in Canada, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, the UK and the US. Use the Email tab for anything else.

found.bodyChat_one: It's in Purchases now, and you're in the event's group chat.
found.bodyChat_other: They're in Purchases now, and you're in each event's group chat.

shared.ticket_one: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so this ticket shows on both. It's one ticket: the QR scans once at the door.
shared.ticket_other: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so these tickets show on both. Each is one ticket: its QR scans once at the door.
shared.pass_one: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so this RSVP shows on both. It's one pass: the QR scans once at the door.
shared.pass_other: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so these RSVPs show on both. Each pass scans once at the door.
shared.booking_one: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so this booking shows on both. It's one booking, shared by both accounts.
shared.booking_other: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so these bookings show on both. Each is one booking, shared by both accounts.
shared.receipt_one: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so this order shows on both. It's one order, shared by both accounts.
shared.receipt_other: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so these orders show on both. Each is one order, shared by both accounts.
shared.mixed: {{value}} is also confirmed on another Mingla account, so these purchases show on both. Each is still just one, shared by both accounts.

none.title: No tickets on {{value}} yet
none.body: It's confirmed and saved, so anything bought with it later lands here by itself. Still missing one?

link.title: Use your confirmation link
link.body: Your Mingla ticket email and text each have a {{action}} link. It takes you straight to the ticket, then we send a quick code to the email or number it was bought with.
link.step1: Open the Mingla email or text about your ticket
link.step2: Tap {{action}}. Mingla opens on the ticket
link.step3: Enter the code we send to that email or number
link.note: You need that inbox or phone for the code. Lost it? Ask the buyer or the host to send the ticket to your current email or number.

ask.title: Ask them to send it
ask.body: The buyer opens the ticket in Mingla, taps {{action}} and enters your email and number. You get a link; once you open it, the ticket is yours. They can take it back until you open it.
ask.message: Hey, can you send me my ticket on Mingla? Open it in the Mingla app and tap Send to a friend. Thanks!
ask.messageWithContacts: Hey, can you send me my ticket on Mingla? Open it in the Mingla app, tap Send to a friend, and use {{contacts}}. Thanks!
ask.privacy: Your details are only added to the message you share.
ask.shareHint: Opens your share sheet: WhatsApp, Messages, anything.
ask.shareFailed: We couldn't open sharing. Try again.

landed.title: Is this your ticket?
landed.bodyEmail: It was bought with {{contact}}. To add it to this account, confirm that email with a 6-digit code.
landed.bodyPhone: It was bought with {{contact}}. To add it to this account, confirm that number with a 6-digit code.
landed.cantInbox: I can't get into that inbox
landed.cantPhone: I can't get to that phone
landed.expired: This link has expired. Ask the buyer or the host to send the ticket to your current email or number.
landed.noContact: We can't send a code for this one. Ask the buyer or the host to send the ticket to your current email or number.
landed.unsupportedPhone: We can't text that number yet. Ask the buyer to send the ticket to you instead.
landed.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. Try again.
